title: Administrative division adjustment and ecological effects: Evidence from China
title_zh: 行政区划调整与生态效应：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 行政区划调整与生态效应：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Administrative division adjustment and ecological effects: Evidence from China
authors: Zhi Li, Jiahui Wang, Kaixi He, Ruting Huang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As urbanization accelerates worldwide, the ecological consequences of administrative boundary reforms remain poorly understood. This study exploits China's County-to-District reform as a quasi-natural experiment to estimate its impact on vegetation cover, using a county-level panel from 2008 to 2020 and a staggered difference-in-differences design. The reform significantly reduces local vegetation cover, with attenuated effects in counties characterized by steeper slopes, greater topographic relief, designated nature reserves, or higher fiscal expenditure. Mechanism analysis reveals a development-oriented political economy channel: the reform intensifies socioeconomic activity, which in turn reshapes land use through built-up expansion and cropland contraction. Evidence from the primary land market corroborates this channel, showing that the reform increases primary land conveyance revenue mainly through commercial and industrial land conveyances. These findings underscore the need to incorporate ecological and fiscal assessments into reform approval procedures and to decouple administrative upgrading from land supply expansion, so that institutional transitions do not come at the expense of long-term environmental quality.

title: Centrality-Based Spillover Effects
title_zh: 基于中心性的溢出效应
title_primary: 基于中心性的溢出效应
title_secondary: Centrality-Based Spillover Effects
authors: Asad Islam, Michael Vlassopoulos, Yves Zenou, Xin Zhang
official: 官方在线 2021-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the role of social network structure in peer-to-peer educational spillovers by leveraging a two-year field experiment in primary schools in rural Bangladesh. We implement a randomized educational intervention-the provision of free after-school tutoring-offered to a random subsample of students in treatment schools. We exploit the experimentally induced across-classroom variation in the centrality of treated students to provide the first causal evidence of centrality-based spillover effects. We find that a one standard deviation (SD) increase in the average centrality of treated students within a classroom leads to improvements in the test scores of their untreated classmates of 0.57 SD in English and 0.62 SD in math. Further evidence indicates that more central students have higher academic ability, better social skills, and interact more with classmates on matters related to learning, which suggests that they can be more influential for their peers. In addition, we offer the private tutoring intervention to the most central students on a separate group of schools. We find that this targeted approach provides larger educational benefits both for treated and untreated students than the policy that treats a random subset of students. We conclude that targeting the most central students in a network to offer an intervention can be a cost-effective way to improve the educational outcomes of all students in a classroom.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用在孟加拉国农村小学开展的一项为期两年的实地实验，研究社会网络结构在同伴教育溢出效应中的作用。我们实施了一项随机教育干预——提供免费课后辅导——并将其提供给治疗学校中随机抽取的一部分学生。我们利用实验所诱导的班级间差异，即受治疗学生中心性的差异，首次提供基于中心性的溢出效应的因果证据。我们发现，班级内受治疗学生平均中心性提高一个标准差（SD），会使其未受治疗同学的考试成绩提高：英语提高0.57个标准差，数学提高0.62个标准差。进一步证据表明，中心性更高的学生具有更高的学业能力、更好的社交技能，并在与学习相关的事务上与同学互动更多，这表明他们可能对同伴更具影响力。此外，我们在另一组学校中向最中心的学生提供私人辅导干预。我们发现，与随机治疗一部分学生的政策相比，这种针对性方法为受治疗和未受治疗学生都带来了更大的教育收益。我们得出结论，针对网络中最中心的学生提供干预，可能是改善班级中所有学生教育成果的一种具有成本效益的方式。

title: The Emergence of the Socioeconomic Gradient in Women’s Marriage Outcomes
title_zh: 女性婚姻结果中社会经济梯度的出现
title_primary: 女性婚姻结果中社会经济梯度的出现
title_secondary: The Emergence of the Socioeconomic Gradient in Women’s Marriage Outcomes
authors: Claudia Olivetti, M. Daniele Paserman, Laura Salisbury, E. Anna Weber
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present new findings about the relationship between marriage and socioeconomic background in the United States in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Imputing the socioeconomic status of family of origin from first names, we document a socioeconomic gradient for women in the probability of marriage and the socioeconomic status of husbands, which widens over this period. Regional divergence in occupational structure explains half of the divergence in the probability of marriage, and most of the increase in marital sorting. Urbanization and the associated improvement in women’s labor market opportunities drive most of these differences.

title: Impact of commodity prices volatility on the sovereign risk of European economies: the case of the Russo-Ukrainian conflict
title_zh: 商品价格波动对欧洲经济体主权风险的影响：以俄乌冲突为例
title_primary: 商品价格波动对欧洲经济体主权风险的影响：以俄乌冲突为例
title_secondary: Impact of commodity prices volatility on the sovereign risk of European economies: the case of the Russo-Ukrainian conflict
authors: Agata Kliber, Małgorzata Just, Krzysztof Echaust
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the Russo-Ukrainian conflict on the relationship between commodity price volatility and sovereign risk in European economies. Focusing on key agricultural commodities (wheat, rapeseed, and maize) and energy commodities (oil, gas, and coal) we examine the situation in European crop exporting and producing countries: France, Germany, Poland, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, Czechia, Italy, Portugal, Spain, the Netherlands, Denmark, Belgium, Finland, and the United Kingdom. Our results reveal that the spillovers originate primarily from the sovereign risk, while commodities are mainly shock receivers. Since the conflict began, the contribution of gas spillovers has increased, while that of wheat, maize, and coal has decreased. Moreover, the transmission of risks from Central Europe and Finland has also intensified. Overall, the findings suggest that geopolitical tensions drive the spillover transmission of commodity-related risk across the European Union and the UK.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了俄乌冲突对欧洲经济体商品价格波动与主权风险之间关系的影响。我们聚焦于主要农产品（小麦、油菜籽和玉米）和能源商品（石油、天然气和煤炭），考察了欧洲农作物出口国和生产国的情况：法国、德国、波兰、罗马尼亚、匈牙利、保加利亚、捷克、意大利、葡萄牙、西班牙、荷兰、丹麦、比利时、芬兰和英国。我们的结果表明，溢出效应主要源自主权风险，而商品则主要是冲击接收方。自冲突开始以来，天然气溢出效应的贡献有所增加，而小麦、玉米和煤炭的贡献则有所下降。此外，来自中欧和芬兰的风险传导也有所加剧。总体而言，研究结果表明，地缘政治紧张局势推动了与商品相关的风险在欧盟和英国之间的溢出传导。

title: Labor mobility and the level of unemployment in a currency union
title_zh: 货币联盟中的劳动力流动性与失业水平
title_primary: 货币联盟中的劳动力流动性与失业水平
title_secondary: Labor mobility and the level of unemployment in a currency union
authors: Erin P. Gibson, Christopher L. House, Christian Proebsting, Linda L. Tesar
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Unemployment rates are substantially higher and more volatile in the euro area relative to the United States. We ask to what extent the lack of cross-country labor mobility can account for unemployment dynamics in Europe. Our analytical model incorporates downward nominal wage rigidity and an endogenous migration decision. Firms are unable to freely adjust wages during economic contractions, generating an asymmetric distribution of unemployment over the business cycle. The model is calibrated to the dynamics of unemployment and net migration in a typical euro area country. An increase in labor mobility to that observed in the United States and holding all other parameters fixed would reduce the volatility of euro area unemployment by 28% and return over 1,000,000 unemployed to the workforce. The welfare cost to a typical euro area country of the currency union is 4.1 percent of permanent consumption; increasing labor mobility reduces this cost to about 3.55 percent.
abstract_zh: 欧元区的失业率相对于美国显著更高且波动性更大。我们探讨了跨国劳动力流动性不足在多大程度上可以解释欧洲的失业动态。我们的分析模型纳入了名义工资刚性下行和内生迁移决策。在经济收缩期间，企业无法自由调整工资，导致失业在商业周期中呈现不对称分布。该模型根据典型欧元区国家的失业和净迁移动态进行了校准。若将劳动力流动性提升至美国水平，并保持所有其他参数不变，欧元区失业率的波动性将降低28%，并使超过100万名失业者重返劳动力市场。货币联盟对典型欧元区国家的福利成本相当于永久消费的4.1%；提高劳动力流动性可将这一成本降至约3.55%。

title: NIL, the transfer portal, and quarterback talent in NCAA football
title_zh: NCAA橄榄球中的NIL、转会门户与四分卫人才
title_primary: NCAA橄榄球中的NIL、转会门户与四分卫人才
title_secondary: NIL, the transfer portal, and quarterback talent in NCAA football
authors: Jack A. Badger, Michael A. Roach
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Recent NCAA policy changes reduced barriers to player mobility and allowed athletes to be compensated for their Name, Image, and Likeness, making the labour market for athletes more competitive. We investigate how these changes affect the distribution of elite quarterback talent within NCAA football. After controlling for the supply of elite quarterbacks, which increases during the NIL period, and team-specific factors, we find no aggregate effect on the likelihood of teams having an elite quarterback on their roster. However, Power conference schools do have significantly more elite quarterbacks on their rosters after the policy change, and this is primarily driven by elite talent moving to schools without a returning starting quarterback. This suggests that these policy changes allow market forces to direct resources where they have an opportunity to be more productive. These findings suggest that market forces are directing elite quarterbacks towards Power programmes where there is a chance to start, and QB talent generally is moving to where it has a clearer path towards playing time. KEYWORDS: NIL football labour mobility sports economics JEL CLASSIFICATION: J08 Z28 J62
abstract_zh: 近期NCAA政策调整降低了球员流动壁垒，并允许运动员就其姓名、形象和肖像权获得补偿，这使得运动员劳动力市场更具竞争性。我们研究了这些变化如何影响NCAA橄榄球中精英四分卫人才的分布。在控制了精英四分卫供给（在NIL时期有所增加）以及球队特定因素后，我们发现这些变化对球队阵容中拥有精英四分卫的可能性没有总体效应。然而，政策变化后，权力联盟学校阵容中的精英四分卫数量显著增加，这主要源于精英人才流向那些没有回归首发四分卫的学校。这表明，这些政策调整使市场力量能够将资源引导至其可能更具生产力的地方。这些发现表明，市场力量正将精英四分卫引向有机会首发的权力联盟项目，而四分卫人才总体上正流向那些上场时间路径更清晰的学校。关键词：NIL 橄榄球 劳动力流动性 体育经济学 JEL分类：J08 Z28 J62

title: A Deep Case for Shallow Integration
title_zh: 浅层一体化的深层论证
title_primary: 浅层一体化的深层论证
title_secondary: A Deep Case for Shallow Integration
authors: John Becko, Arnaud Costinot
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study international cooperation in a general environment with pecuniary and non-pecuniary externalities across countries. We derive two main theorems, each demonstrating that market-access commitments, a form of shallow integration, are sufficient to implement globally efficient policies. When all cross-border externalities are pecuniary, the first theorem provides a new and unifying perspective on a series of results by Bagwell and Staiger. When some cross-border externalities are non-pecuniary, the second theorem shows that market-access commitments, properly extended, still sustain global efficiency. These extended market-access commitments reinterpret cross-border externalities as additional goods that are traded and priced at their social values. We discuss the implications for international cooperation on climate change and geopolitics.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在跨国金钱性外部性与非金钱性外部性的普遍环境中的国际合作。我们推导出两个主要定理，各自证明市场准入承诺——一种浅层一体化形式——足以实施全球高效政策。当所有跨境外部性均为金钱性时，第一个定理为巴格韦尔和斯泰格的一系列结果提供了新的统一视角。当部分跨境外部性为非金钱性时，第二个定理表明，适当扩展的市场准入承诺仍能维持全球效率。这些扩展的市场准入承诺将跨境外部性重新诠释为额外商品，按其社会价值进行交易和定价。我们讨论了这些发现对气候变化和地缘政治国际合作的启示。

title: Reparations and Persistent Racial Wealth Gaps
title_zh: 赔偿与持续存在的种族财富差距
title_primary: 赔偿与持续存在的种族财富差距
title_secondary: Reparations and Persistent Racial Wealth Gaps
authors: Job Boerma, Loukas Karabarbounis
official: 官方在线 2022-05-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze the magnitude and persistence of the racial wealth gap using a long-run model of heterogeneous dynasties with an occupational choice and bequests. Our innovation is to introduce endogenous beliefs about risky returns, reflecting differences in dynasties' investment experiences over time. Feeding the exclusion of Black dynasties from labor and capital markets into the model as the only driving force, we find that the model quantitatively reproduces current and historical racial gaps in wealth, income, entrepreneurship, mobility, and beliefs about risky returns. We explore how the future trajectory of the racial wealth gap might change in response to various policies. Wealth transfers to all Black dynasties that eliminate the average wealth gap today do not lead to long-run wealth convergence. The logic is that centuries-long exclusions lead Black dynasties to hold pessimistic beliefs about risky returns and to forgo investment opportunities after the wealth transfer. Investment subsidies toward Black entrepreneurs are more effective than wealth transfers in permanently eliminating the racial wealth gap.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个包含职业选择与遗产的长期异质性家族模型，分析了种族财富差距的规模与持续性。我们的创新之处在于引入关于风险回报的内生信念，这些信念反映了不同家族随时间推移的投资经历。将黑人家族被排除在劳动力和资本市场之外作为模型中唯一的驱动因素，我们发现该模型定量再现了当前及历史上的财富、收入、创业、流动性以及关于风险回报信念方面的种族差距。我们探讨了未来种族财富差距的轨迹可能如何因各种政策而改变。向所有黑人家族进行的财富转移，即便消除了当前的平均财富差距，也不会导致长期财富趋同。其逻辑在于，长达数世纪的排斥使黑人家族对风险回报持有悲观信念，并在财富转移后放弃投资机会。相较于财富转移，针对黑人企业家的投资补贴在永久消除种族财富差距方面更为有效。

title: Covenant-Driven Fire Sales
title_zh: 契约驱动的抛售
title_primary: 契约驱动的抛售
title_secondary: Covenant-Driven Fire Sales
authors: Kundu, Shohini
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Covenants mitigate agency frictions but can trigger asset sales at fire sale prices. I demonstrate covenant-driven fire sales and trace their real effects. Following a large negative oil-price shock, collateralized loan obligations exposed to oil-and-gas (O&G) firms approach their covenant thresholds and sell non-O&G loans, exerting price-pressure on non-O&G bonds and loans in primary and secondary markets. Affected non-O&G borrowers experience declines in financing, investment, R&D, and employment. Instrumenting CLO net loan sales with lenders’ O&G exposure, a one-percentage-point increase reduces firm investment by 0.08 percentage-points, 5% of mean investment. Covenant-induced liquidations can thus generate credit crunches via capital-market contagion.
abstract_zh: 契约条款能够缓解代理摩擦，但也可能在火线价格下触发资产出售。我展示了由契约驱动的火线销售及其实际影响。在油价大幅负面冲击之后，暴露于油气（O&G）企业的抵押贷款债务（CLO）接近其契约阈值，并出售非油气贷款，对一级和二级市场上的非油气债券和贷款施加价格压力。受影响的非油气借款人经历了融资、投资、研发和就业的下降。以贷款方的油气敞口作为CLO净贷款销售的工具变量，一个百分点的增加会使企业投资减少0.08个百分点，相当于平均投资的5%。因此，契约引发的清算可能通过资本市场传染导致信贷紧缩。

title: Monthly Income Variability and Its Consequences: Evidence from SNAP Administrative Data
title_zh: 月收入波动及其后果：来自SNAP行政数据的证据
title_primary: 月收入波动及其后果：来自SNAP行政数据的证据
title_secondary: Monthly Income Variability and Its Consequences: Evidence from SNAP Administrative Data
authors: Carpenter, Craig Wesley, Cotti, Chad
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Research shows that the receipt and timing of income can significantly influence behavior, including risky behaviors and health indicators such as mortality and emergency department visits. These effects have been linked to the timing of income benefits and transfers, such as those provided by the U.S. Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). We leverage exogenous variation in the monthly date on which individuals receive SNAP benefits, combined with linked individual-level state and federal administrative microdata, to estimate: (1) the causal effects of days since SNAP (income) receipt within a monthly benefit cycle, and (2) the causal effects of the monthly distribution date (income smoothing) on labor market and health outcomes across months. We show that (1) as the days since SNAP distribution increases, work absenteeism increases and labor market participation decreases until just before the next monthly issuance of SNAP benefits, when outcomes begin to improve again. We directly test food insecurity and health as mechanisms for these labor market cycles and show that they also follow the 30-day benefits cycle. Controlling for these 30-day benefit cycles, we then estimate (2) the causal effect of monthly distribution date on labor market participation, health, and food insecurity. We find evidence that if states distributed SNAP in the middle of a calendar month, rather than the beginning or end of a month, SNAP recipient labor market participation would increase, reported disability would decrease, food insecurity would decrease, and the lifespan of SNAP participants—which we capture by linking the universe of Social Security Administration individual death records—would increase by 101 days (0.5%), on average.
abstract_zh: 研究表明，收入的获得及其时间安排能显著影响行为，包括冒险行为及死亡率、急诊就诊等健康指标。这些影响已与收入福利及转移支付的时间安排相关联，例如美国补充营养援助计划（SNAP）所提供的福利。我们利用个人每月领取SNAP福利日期中的外生变异，结合关联的个人层面州及联邦行政微观数据，以估计：（1）在一个月度福利周期内，自SNAP（收入）领取以来天数对劳动力市场及健康结果的因果效应；（2）月度发放日期（收入平滑化）对跨月劳动力市场及健康结果的因果效应。我们发现：（1）随着SNAP发放后天数增加，工作缺勤率上升，劳动力市场参与率下降，直至下月SNAP福利发放前夕，各项结果方开始再度改善。我们直接检验食物不安全及健康作为这些劳动力市场周期的机制，并显示它们同样遵循30天福利周期。在控制这些30天福利周期后，我们进而估计（2）月度发放日期对劳动力市场参与、健康及食物不安全的因果效应。我们发现证据表明，若各州在日历月中旬而非月初或月末发放SNAP福利，则SNAP受助者的劳动力市场参与率将上升，报告的残疾率将下降，食物不安全状况将减轻，且SNAP参与者的寿命——我们通过关联社会保障管理局全体个人死亡记录来捕捉——平均将增加101天（0.5%）。

title: Big Bias from Small Treatment Heterogeneity: When Controlling for Selection Backfires
title_zh: 小处理异质性导致的大偏差：控制选择效应适得其反时
title_primary: 小处理异质性导致的大偏差：控制选择效应适得其反时
title_secondary: Big Bias from Small Treatment Heterogeneity: When Controlling for Selection Backfires
authors: Carro, Jesús M., Von Lampe, Gregor
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Applied work routinely estimates treatment effects by linear regression of theoutcome on a treatment indicator and controls, with no interactions between them. We show that, even when selection is entirely on observables and the linear model is correctly specified, minimal unmodeled treatment effect heterogeneity can produce large biases for the average treatment effect on the treated. We decompose the asymptotic bias, control by control, into the product of an unobservable heterogeneity component and an observable amplifier, estimable without outcome data, that grows without bound as the controls better explain treatment. Covariates irrelevant for the outcome are not innocuous: they can generate large biases while their spuriously significant estimates make them self-validating. We propose breakdown diagnostics: the minimal correlated heterogeneity that overturns an estimate. In difference-in-differences, group-specific trends, a standard robustness check, absorb the dynamics of the treatment effect, producing a bias that accumulates with the length of the panel. Applications to 401(k) eligibility and unilateral divorce laws illustrate.
abstract_zh: 应用研究通常通过将结果变量对处理指标和控制变量进行线性回归来估计处理效应，且不包含两者之间的交互项。我们证明，即使选择完全基于可观测变量且线性模型设定正确，最小的未建模处理效应异质性也可能对受处理者的平均处理效应产生较大偏差。我们将渐近偏差逐控制变量分解为不可观测异质性成分与可观测放大器的乘积，后者无需结果数据即可估计，且随着控制变量对处理的解释力增强而无界增长。与结果无关的协变量并非无害：它们可能产生较大偏差，同时其虚假显著的估计值使其具有自我验证性。我们提出崩溃诊断方法：即推翻估计所需的最小相关异质性。在双重差分法中，组特定趋势作为标准稳健性检验，吸收了处理效应的动态变化，从而产生随面板长度累积的偏差。对401(k)资格和单方离婚法的应用研究说明了上述问题。

title: Global Banks’ Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Supply
title_zh: 全球银行宏观经济预期与信贷供给
title_primary: 全球银行宏观经济预期与信贷供给
title_secondary: Global Banks’ Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Supply
authors: Xiang Li, Steven Ongena, Kenza Benhima, Isabella Blengini, Ouarda Merrouche 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-10 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: We investigate how global banks’ macroeconomic expectations for borrower countries influence their credit supply. Utilizing granular data on varying expectations among banks lending to the same firm at the same time, combined with an instrumental variable approach, we find that more optimistic GDP growth expectations for a borrower country are strongly linked to increased credit supply. Specifically, a one standard deviation increase in a lender’s GDP growth expectation for the borrower’s country corresponds to an increase of 8.46 percentage points in the loan share, equivalent to approximately 0.75 standard deviations of the loan share and $75.35 million in loan amount. In contrast, global banks’ short-term inflation expectations do not show a significant impact on their credit supply.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了全球银行对借款国宏观经济预期如何影响其信贷供给。利用同一时间向同一企业放贷的银行间预期差异的微观数据，并结合工具变量方法，我们发现对借款国GDP增长更为乐观的预期与信贷供给增加紧密相关。具体而言，贷款方对借款国GDP增长预期每提高一个标准差，贷款份额相应增加8.46个百分点，这相当于贷款份额标准差的约0.75倍，以及贷款金额约7535万美元。相比之下，全球银行的短期通胀预期对其信贷供给并未显示出显著影响。

title: Capital Unemployment
title_zh: 资本失业
title_primary: 资本失业
title_secondary: Capital Unemployment
authors: Pablo Ottonello
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the unemployment of physical capital—defined as idle units searching to be traded—and its macroeconomic implications. I provide evidence documenting that capital unemployment is large, volatile, and increases during economic downturns. I construct a capital-accumulation model that explains these patterns, with trading frictions in capital markets, which give rise to equilibrium capital unemployment, and financial shocks, which lead to large fluctuations in trading probabilities and capital unemployment. Using the model, I show that trading frictions and capital unemployment matter for aggregate dynamics. First, unemployed capital affects aggregate investment dynamics: Downturns characterized by large increases in unemployed capital are followed by investment slumps, because the economy tends to recover by absorbing existing unemployed capital rather than by producing new capital goods. Second, capital unemployment constitutes a propagation mechanism from financial shocks to economic activity, which shows up at the aggregate level as measured total factor productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究实物资本失业——即闲置且寻求交易的资本单位——及其宏观经济影响。我提供了证据，表明资本失业规模庞大、波动剧烈，并在经济衰退期间加剧。我构建了一个资本积累模型，该模型通过资本市场的交易摩擦解释了这些现象，这些摩擦导致均衡状态下的资本失业，而金融冲击则引发交易概率和资本失业的大幅波动。

title: Complementarity, congestion and information design in epidemics with strategic social behaviour
title_zh: 流行病中策略性社会行为下的互补性、拥堵与信息设计
title_primary: 流行病中策略性社会行为下的互补性、拥堵与信息设计
title_secondary: Complementarity, congestion and information design in epidemics with strategic social behaviour
authors: Davide Bosco, Luca Portoghese
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the context of an epidemic where the risk of death post-infection depends on demography and social behaviour, this paper characterises how the degree of congestibility of the social environment and the public/private nature of the available information about health states jointly affect the strategic social distancing of demographically heterogeneous agents. Key result is that the joint presence of congestibility and private information is necessary and sufficient for social-distancing decisions to be strategic complements. Strategic substitutability ensues in every other case. Within the limits of the proposed model, the analysis provides a sound theoretical rationale for the heterogeneity in the results provided by the extant literature on the issue. Implications ensue for optimal information design. First: limiting private information (e.g. by forbidding self-tests) is always socially optimal. Second: if private information cannot be limited, the second-best policy crucially depends on environmental congestibility: with high congestibility, providing the maximum extent of public information (e.g. via mass screening campaigns) is desirable, whereas the converse is true with low congestibility.
abstract_zh: 在感染后死亡风险取决于人口结构和社会行为的流行病背景下，本文刻画了社会环境拥挤程度以及健康状态信息的公共/私人属性如何共同影响人口异质性主体的策略性社交距离行为。关键结论是，拥挤性与私人信息的共同存在是社交距离决策成为战略互补品的充分必要条件。在其他所有情形下，则表现为战略替代性。在模型设定范围内，分析为现有文献中关于该问题结果异质性提供了坚实的理论依据。这对最优信息设计具有启示意义。第一：限制私人信息（例如禁止自我检测）始终是社会最优的。第二：若私人信息无法限制，次优政策则关键取决于环境拥挤程度：在高拥挤性下，提供最大程度的公共信息（例如通过大规模筛查活动）是可取的；而在低拥挤性下，情况则相反。

title: Service imports, workforce composition, and firm performance: Evidence from Finnish microdata
title_zh: 服务进口、劳动力结构与企业绩效：来自芬兰微观数据的证据
title_primary: 服务进口、劳动力结构与企业绩效：来自芬兰微观数据的证据
title_secondary: Service imports, workforce composition, and firm performance: Evidence from Finnish microdata
authors: Andrea Ariu, Katariina Nilsson Hakkala, J. Bradford Jensen, Saara Tamminen
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses unique Finnish firm-level micro data on service imports, employment, and firm characteristics to analyze changes in workforce composition and performance of Finnish service importers during a period of a significant increase in service imports (2002–2012). We utilize country-service specific export supply shocks, which we allocate to firms based on their highly specialized service-origin input structure, as an instrument to identify the impact of sourcing services from abroad. Our analysis indicates that sourcing services internationally offers firms considerable opportunities to enhance productivity and competitiveness. However, the analysis also reveals potential challenges, particularly for workers in low- and medium-skilled occupations, who experienced reduced employment, whereas managers and high-skilled professionals benefited from employment growth. These effects are broad: they involve workers beyond low-skilled occupations and firms across manufacturing and service sectors.
abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰独特的关于服务进口、就业及企业特征的企业层面微观数据，分析了在服务进口显著增长时期（2002-2012年）芬兰服务进口企业的劳动力构成变化及绩效表现。我们利用国家-服务特定的出口供给冲击，根据企业高度专业化的服务来源投入结构将其分配到各企业，作为识别从国外采购服务影响的工具变量。分析表明，国际服务采购为企业提升生产率和竞争力提供了可观机遇。然而，分析也揭示了潜在挑战，尤其是对低技能和中等技能职业的工人而言，他们经历了就业减少，而管理人员和高技能专业人员则受益于就业增长。这些影响具有广泛性：涉及低技能职业以外的工人，以及制造业和服务业中的各类企业。

title: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
title_zh: 集中度、加成率与劳动份额下降的分析性异质主体宏观模型
title_primary: 集中度、加成率与劳动份额下降的分析性异质主体宏观模型
title_secondary: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
authors: Karsten Kohler, Jo Michell, Ayoze Alfageme
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper presents an analytical heterogeneous agent model (HAM) to explore micro-level concentration dynamics and their effects on macro-level distribution and growth. It contributes to recent work on macroeconomic agent-based models (ABMs) by comparing a small-scale ABM with bilateral firm-customer matching to a simplified HAM without direct agent interactions. The HAM replicates key ABM results while allowing for analytical solutions. In the model, larger firms benefit from lower unit costs due to economies of scale, gain larger market shares, and set higher markups. More profitable firms temporarily grow faster, leading to endogenous changes in the firm size distribution. The resulting right-skewed distributions create a divergence between the average profit share across firms and the aggregate profit share, which is driven by the largest firms. The decline in the labour share reduces aggregate consumption and slows growth. Despite its simplicity, the model captures key empirical patterns related to superstar firms and declining labour shares.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析性异质主体模型（HAM），旨在探究微观层面的集中动态及其对宏观分配与增长的影响。该研究通过将一个小规模、具有双边企业-客户匹配的基于主体的模型（ABM）与一个简化、无直接主体互动的HAM进行对比，为近期宏观经济基于主体模型的研究做出了贡献。HAM在允许解析解的同时，复现了ABM的关键结果。在该模型中，规模较大的企业因规模经济而享有较低的单位成本，获得更大的市场份额，并设定更高的加成率。盈利能力更强的企业暂时增长更快，导致企业规模分布发生内生变化。由此产生的右偏分布造成了企业间平均利润份额与总体利润份额之间的差异，后者由最大型企业主导。劳动份额的下降减少了总消费并减缓了增长。尽管模型简洁，它仍捕捉到了与超级明星企业和劳动份额下降相关的主要经验模式。

title: Panel conditioning in measuring financial behavior and expectations
title_zh: 测量金融行为与预期中的固定样本连续调查偏差
title_primary: 测量金融行为与预期中的固定样本连续调查偏差
title_secondary: Panel conditioning in measuring financial behavior and expectations
authors: Alexandru Cernat, Joseph W. Sakshaug, Bella Struminskaya, Susanne Helmschrott, Tobias Schmidt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the phenomenon of panel conditioning and its impact on the reliability and stability of financial behavior and expectation measurements collected through a high-frequency longitudinal survey. Panel conditioning occurs when repeated participation in a survey influences respondents' behaviors and responses, potentially leading to biased data. Utilizing a quasi-experimental design and structural equation modelling, we analyze data from a monthly online survey to assess whether panel participation affects data quality, namely, reliability and stability. Our findings indicate that panel conditioning can lead to a slight increase in the reliability and stability over time. This research contributes to the broader understanding of panel conditioning effects, offering methodological guidance for future studies in this domain.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了固定样本条件化现象及其对通过高频纵向调查所收集的金融行为与预期测量的可靠性和稳定性的影响。固定样本条件化是指反复参与调查会影响受访者的行为和回答，从而可能导致数据偏误。我们采用准实验设计和结构方程模型，分析了一项月度在线调查的数据，以评估样本参与是否会影响数据质量，即可靠性和稳定性。研究结果表明，固定样本条件化可能随着时间推移导致可靠性和稳定性略有提高。本研究有助于加深对固定样本条件化效应的整体理解，并为该领域的未来研究提供方法学指导。

title: On the Foundations of Wage Bargaining
title_zh: 论工资谈判的基础
title_primary: 论工资谈判的基础
title_secondary: On the Foundations of Wage Bargaining
authors: Dennis Snower
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides strategic foundations for the insight that the bargaining power of employees depends on the firm?s labour turnover costs. The analysis shows how these costs determine the firm?s degree of substitutability between two sets of wage negotiations: (i) those the firm conducts with its incumbent employees; and (ii) the alternative negotiations it could conduct with new job seekers. In this context, labour turnover costs not only influence the negotiators? alternatives to bargaining (i.e. the negotiators? fall-back positions and outside options); they affect the nature of the bargaining process itself. This approach leads to a new theory of wage determination.
abstract_zh: 本文为“员工议价能力取决于企业劳动力流动成本”这一洞见提供了战略基础。分析表明，这些成本如何决定企业在两类工资谈判之间的替代程度：（i）企业与现有员工进行的谈判；（ii）企业可能与新求职者进行的替代性谈判。在此背景下，劳动力流动成本不仅影响谈判者的议价替代方案（即谈判者的退路位置和外部选择），还影响谈判过程本身的本质。这一方法引出了一个新的工资决定理论。

title: Melitz meets Lewis: The impacts of roads on structural transformation and businesses
title_zh: 梅利茨遇见刘易斯：道路对结构转型与企业的影响
title_primary: 梅利茨遇见刘易斯：道路对结构转型与企业的影响
title_secondary: Melitz meets Lewis: The impacts of roads on structural transformation and businesses
authors: Joseph P. Kaboski, Will Jianyu Lu, Wei Qian, Lixia Ren
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the impact of roads on structural transformation and business composition both empirically and theoretically. Empirically, we find that major highway programs in India and China led to declines in the number of businesses where structural transformation is weak, and increases where it is strong. We develop a two-sector model of regional trade with endogenous firm entry that highlights two opposing forces. Ceteris paribus , lower trade costs in non-agriculture lead to fewer firms, but cheaper agricultural imports release labor from local agricultural production, leading to more firms. We show that the model-simulated outcomes reasonably replicate the empirical results, and that more rapid agricultural productivity growth in China differentiates the two countries.
abstract_zh: 本文从实证与理论两个层面探讨了道路建设对结构转型及企业构成的影响。实证研究发现，印度与中国的重大高速公路项目导致结构转型薄弱地区的企业数量减少，而结构转型强劲地区的企业数量增加。我们构建了一个包含内生企业进入的两部门区域贸易模型，揭示了两种相反的作用力：在其他条件不变的情况下，非农业贸易成本的降低会导致企业数量减少，但更廉价的农产品进口会释放本地农业劳动力，从而促使企业数量增加。研究表明，模型模拟结果能够合理复现实证结论，且中国更快的农业生产力增长是两国差异的关键因素。

title: Monitoring and delivering: Evidence from dropout rates in Brazil
title_zh: 监控与交付：来自巴西辍学率的证据
title_primary: 监控与交付：来自巴西辍学率的证据
title_secondary: Monitoring and delivering: Evidence from dropout rates in Brazil
authors: Bruno Kömel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides evidence that audits can be an effective instrument for improving public services, depending on institutional and sectoral conditions. Leveraging randomized audits of municipal funds in Brazil, I show that audits led to better outcomes for public school students, but were not as effective in improving the provision of other public services. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, I show causal evidence that the audits led to a decrease in dropout rates in municipal elementary and middle schools by 0.41 percentage points (17%), and that this effect persisted for more than eight years. These estimates correspond to approximately one-third of the decrease in dropout rates resulting from the early years of Bolsa Família, a conditional cash transfer program partially designed to minimize student abandonment. The audits were most effective in municipalities where high levels of corruption were uncovered, and whose residents relied heavily on conditional cash transfers.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了证据表明，审计能否成为改善公共服务的有效工具，取决于制度与部门条件。利用巴西市政资金随机审计，我展示了审计改善了公立学校学生的成果，但在提升其他公共服务供给方面效果不彰。采用双重差分策略，我提供了因果证据，表明审计使市政小学和初中的辍学率下降了0.41个百分点（17%），且这一效应持续超过八年。这些估计值相当于早期“家庭补助金”计划（一项部分旨在减少学生辍学的有条件现金转移项目）所带来辍学率下降的三分之一左右。审计在腐败问题严重且居民高度依赖有条件现金转移的市政区域效果最为显著。

title: The inconvenient truth of problemistic search: real earnings management
title_zh: 问题搜索的不便真相：真实盈余管理
title_primary: 问题搜索的不便真相：真实盈余管理
title_secondary: The inconvenient truth of problemistic search: real earnings management
authors: Juil Lee, Sang-Joon Kim, Kyung Min Park
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how negative performance feedback is associated with real earnings management (REM) and how firm-level market power conditions that relationship. Building on the behavioural theory of the firm and threat-rigidity theory, we argue that performance shortfalls direct organizational attention towards responses that are immediate, proximate, and risk-acceptable. REM fits this behavioural profile because it can alter reported outcomes through real operating decisions while remaining less directly visible than many accounting choices or illegal actions. Using 23,629 firm-year observations for publicly listed U.S. firms from 1992 to 2018, we find that larger performance shortfalls are associated with higher REM. We also find that this relationship weakens as market power increases. Additional analyses support a cautious interpretation: the evidence is more consistent with shortfall-driven opportunistic REM than with a purely strategic or efficiency-enhancing explanation, although standard REM proxies do not directly identify managerial intent. The findings contribute to applied research on firm behaviour under performance pressure by showing that market power can alter the way firms respond to adverse feedback through real operating decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了负面绩效反馈如何影响真实盈余管理（REM），以及企业层面的市场势力如何调节这一关系。基于企业行为理论与威胁-刚性理论，我们提出：绩效缺口会将组织注意力导向即时、直接且风险可接受的应对措施。真实盈余管理符合这一行为特征——它通过实际经营决策改变报告业绩，同时相较于诸多会计选择或违法行为具有更低的直接可见性。基于1992年至2018年间美国上市公司23,629个公司-年度观测值，本研究发现：绩效缺口越大，真实盈余管理程度越高；市场势力越强，该正向关联越弱。进一步分析支持审慎解读：证据更倾向于表明绩效缺口驱动机会主义型真实盈余管理，而非纯粹战略或效率提升型解释——尽管标准真实盈余管理代理变量无法直接识别管理层意图。本研究通过揭示市场势力如何改变企业通过实际经营决策应对负面反馈的方式，为绩效压力下企业行为的应用研究提供了新见解。

title: Making connections: access and market competition with public broadband
title_zh: 建立连接：公共宽带接入与市场竞争
title_primary: 建立连接：公共宽带接入与市场竞争
title_secondary: Making connections: access and market competition with public broadband
authors: Mark F. Owens, Adam D. Rennhoff
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use causal forests to examine how public utility broadband providers are associated with broadband adoption and local market structure across 194 counties in Tennessee and Iowa, 38 of which have a public utility broadband provider. Public provider presence is associated with an average 6% point higher broadband adoption share, lower private-carrier market shares, and lower measured market concentration, though the latter partly reflects the mechanical effect of an additional provider on the concentration index. The estimated adoption difference is largest in lower-income and urban counties and in counties where public providers have greater geographic reach and offer lower prices. Given the cross-sectional design, limited number of treated counties, and the observable income imbalance between treated and untreated counties, we interpret these results as a transparent, explicitly associational account of structured heterogeneity in broadband outcomes rather than as causal estimates; sensitivity analyses indicate that the income heterogeneity patterns are not driven solely by the observable selection margin.
abstract_zh: 我们采用因果森林方法，考察公共事业宽带提供商如何与田纳西州和爱荷华州194个县的宽带普及率及本地市场结构相关联，其中38个县拥有公共事业宽带提供商。公共提供商的存在与宽带普及率平均高出6个百分点、私营运营商市场份额降低以及市场集中度下降相关——尽管后者部分反映了新增提供商对集中度指数的机械性影响。宽带普及率差异在低收入县、城市县以及公共提供商地理覆盖范围更广、定价更低的县中最为显著。鉴于本研究采用横截面设计、受处理县数量有限，且受处理县与未受处理县之间存在可观测的收入不平衡，我们将这些结果解读为对宽带结果中结构化异质性的透明、明确关联性描述，而非因果估计；敏感性分析表明，收入异质性模式并非仅由可观测的选择性边界驱动。

title: When Competition Needs Awareness: Regulating Social Media with Naive Users
title_zh: 当竞争需要意识：对具有天真用户的社交媒体进行监管

abstract: Can intensifying competition protect social media users? The answer depends on users’ awareness of the harms of social media content. We develop a model of asymmetric competition between platforms with naive users, in which platforms choose how much to amplify harmful yet engaging content. Naive users do not internalize the adverse effects of consuming this content. Otherwise, intensifying competition can backfire by inducing this platform to exploit naive users. Awareness initiatives complement competition policy by making exploitation less attractive, but may increase market concentration.

abstract: In this paper, we consider the relationship between poultry processing industry concentration and labor costs at the industry level using plant-level data for all poultry processing facilities in the U.S. We find that plant acquisition by an industry leader firm generates an increase in future sales-per-employee at the plant in subsequent periods. Increased ownership concentration at both the national and state-level leads to a reduction in poultry processing worker renumeration, relative to the compensation for comparable jobs in other sectors. Relative to concentration and consolidation levels 25 years ago, these developments have led to between $37 and $710 million in additional revenues per year and between $27 and $218 million savings in the aggregate wage bill for the four largest poultry firms, implying a 2.6–12.0% increase in the gross labor margin for these firms.

abstract: This paper addresses two main questions. First, what proportion of people are exposed to climate hazards in Latin America and the Caribbean, especially among the poor versus the nonpoor? Second, do certain areas—hotspots—have high rates of bothhazard exposure and poverty that require targeted policy? Using poverty maps and georeferenced climate hazard data, three innovations are introduced: five climate hazards are analyzed (droughts, hurricanes, heatwaves, floods, and landslides); official poverty data at administrative level 2 are used, instead of only administrative level 1; and an interpolation method estimates poverty-plus-exposure rates across countries with varying data sources. The estimates indicate that 36.9 percent of the population is exposed to at least one of the five climate hazards under consideration. Considering the population in poverty only, the percentage is higher, 44.6 percent, whereas the exposure rate for the nonpoor is 34.0 percent. Some areas experience high exposure to climate hazards and high poverty rates. These hotspots include about 10 percent of the region’s population. These areas are in the Brazilian northeast; the upper-Amazon region of Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Brazil; the Chaco region of Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay; the islands of the Caribbean; the western coast of the Gulf of California; and the Yucatan Peninsula.
abstract_zh: 本文主要探讨两个问题：第一，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区有多少人口暴露于气候灾害中，尤其是贫困与非贫困群体之间的差异？第二，是否存在某些区域——即灾害暴露与贫困率均较高的“热点地区”——需要针对性政策干预？通过整合贫困地图与地理参照气候灾害数据，本文引入三项创新：分析五种气候灾害（干旱、飓风、热浪、洪水和山体滑坡）；采用二级行政区划的官方贫困数据（而非仅使用一级行政区划数据）；并运用插值法估算不同数据来源国家间的“贫困-暴露”复合率。估算结果显示，36.9%的人口至少暴露于所研究的五种气候灾害之一。若仅考虑贫困人口，该比例上升至44.6%，而非贫困人口的暴露率为34.0%。部分区域同时呈现高气候灾害暴露率与高贫困率，这些热点地区约占区域总人口的10%，主要分布于巴西东北部；哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁与巴西的上亚马逊地区；阿根廷、巴西与巴拉圭的大查科地区；加勒比群岛；加利福尼亚湾西海岸以及尤卡坦半岛。

title: BGBI: A citywide-referenced and bidirectional land use mix index for planning and policy evaluation

authors: Jorge Ubirajara Pedreira Junior, Thiago Vinícius Louro, Lucas Brandão Monteiro de Assis, Patrícia Lustosa Brito, Fabio Garboggini Bomfim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land use mix (LUM) metrics provide actionable evidence to monitor planning goals and prioritize interventions, including transit-oriented development, zoning revisions, and urban retrofits. Yet common measures suffer from two main limitations that often render them difficult to translate into decisions. First, all measures summarize how mixed a place is without indicating the direction of the mix, i.e. whether a homogeneous area is predominantly residential or non-residential. Second, most metrics attain their maximum LUM value at a 50/50 split, even when the citywide composition is highly asymmetric. Here we introduce the Bidirectional Global-centered Balance Index (BGBI), a bounded signed index for land use composition that preserves directionality and centers interpretation on the observed citywide reference share. We compute BGBI alongside four widely used benchmarks and empirically validate all indices against job accessibility metrics by testing whether each measure’s implied balance target coincides with accessibility optima. The analysis uses point address data to measure LUM in terms of residential and non-residential shares aggregated in H3 hexagonal grids for three Brazilian cities. The full workflow can be executed using an open-source R package, which supports reproducible computation of all indices across multiple H3 resolutions and facilitates straightforward replication and sensitivity checks. Our results indicate that the highest-accessibility locations occur near baseline-centered balance (BGBI ≅ 0), rather than near the 50/50 reference implicit in many conventional metrics. These results show that interpretability properties can change diagnostic conclusions and suggest that baseline-centered directionality provides a practical target for planning and policy monitoring.
abstract_zh: 土地利用混合（LUM）指标为监测规划目标及优先干预措施（如公交导向开发、分区修订和城市更新）提供了可操作的证据。然而，常用度量方法存在两大局限，往往难以转化为决策依据。首先，所有度量均仅概括某地的混合程度，而未指明混合方向，即同质区域是以住宅为主还是非住宅为主。其次，多数指标在50/50比例时达到最大LUM值，即便城市整体构成高度不对称。本文引入双向全局中心平衡指数（BGBI），这是一种有界的有符号土地利用构成指数，既保留方向性，又以观测到的城市整体参考份额为中心进行解释。我们将BGBI与四种广泛使用的基准指标一并计算，并通过检验各指标隐含的平衡目标是否与可达性最优值一致，对所有指标进行实证验证，以对照就业可达性指标。分析采用点地址数据，以住宅与非住宅份额衡量LUM，并在三个巴西城市的H3六边形网格中聚合。完整工作流程可通过开源R包执行，支持在多种H3分辨率下对所有指标进行可复现计算，便于直接复制和敏感性检验。结果表明，最高可达性位置出现在接近基线中心平衡（BGBI ≅ 0）处，而非许多传统指标隐含的50/50参考点附近。这些结果说明，可解释性特征可能改变诊断结论，并提示以基线为中心的方向性可为规划与政策监测提供实用目标。

abstract: We examine the impact of public versus private television content on political engagement and accountability during the initial rollout of Canada’s television network in the early 1950s. A policy prohibiting market competition restricted districts to receiving either public or private programming, but never both. While both station types aired the public broadcaster’s national service, private stations bundled this content with local news. We find that exposure to the public broadcaster reduced voter turnout by 2.1 percentage points relative to districts without television, while engagement in private television districts remained indistinguishable from pre-television levels. This lack of engagement weakened re-election incentives and increased the incumbency advantage. Consequently, incumbents in public districts spoke less about their constituencies in parliament and demonstrated greater party loyalty in roll-call votes—results consistent with a significant reduction in political accountability.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了20世纪50年代初加拿大电视网络初步推广期间，公共与私营电视内容对政治参与和问责制的影响。一项禁止市场竞争的政策限制各地区只能接收公共或私营节目，但从未同时接收两者。尽管两种类型的电视台都播出了公共广播公司的全国性服务，但私营电视台将这一内容与本地新闻捆绑在一起。我们发现，与没有电视的地区相比，接触公共广播公司使选民投票率降低了2.1个百分点，而私营电视地区的参与度则与电视出现前水平无显著差异。这种参与度的缺失削弱了连任激励，并增加了在位优势。因此，公共电视地区的在位者在议会中较少谈论其选区事务，并在唱名表决中表现出更强的党派忠诚度——这些结果与政治问责制显著减弱相一致。

authors: Marc Deloof
official: 官方在线 2026-03-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the role of financial elites in the Congo Free State (CFS). An analysis of director interlocks between firms operating in the CFS and Belgian banks listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange (BSE) reveals that the Belgian financial establishment was a crucial contributor to large, capital‐intensive CFS ventures from the start, contradicting the idea that business in the CFS was driven by a few rogue financiers. Whilst the number of CFS firms was small and their economic importance was limited, almost all the large financial firms, including the Société Générale de Belgique, had two or more CFS firm directors on their board. Financial firms were much more involved in large CFS ventures than in other similar Belgian firms operating abroad.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了金融精英在刚果自由邦（CFS）中的作用。通过对在CFS运营的企业与布鲁塞尔证券交易所（BSE）上市的比利时银行之间的董事关联网络进行分析，发现比利时金融界从一开始就是CFS大型资本密集型项目的重要贡献者，这与CFS商业活动由少数不法金融家驱动的观点相悖。尽管CFS企业数量不多，其经济重要性有限，但几乎所有大型金融企业，包括比利时总公司（Société Générale de Belgique），其董事会中至少有两名CFS企业董事。金融企业对CFS大型项目的参与程度远高于对其他类似的比利时海外企业。

official: 官方在线 2025-11-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Geographical indications (GIs) are an increasingly important feature of global agri-food markets and trade agreements, yet the economic literature lacks a structural open-economy model to analyze how GI policies influence exports, productivity, and welfare. To fill this gap, we develop a general equilibrium model of international trade that captures essential features of GI production and policies in both domestic and international markets. Production features include the craftsmanship of GI products and the collective culture of GI producers. GI policies focus on institutional frameworks and financial support for the collective management of GIs, as well as administrative protection (ex officio protection) of the GI label. The model accommodates cross-country asymmetries in the endowment of GI sectors, as well as in the implementation and strength of GI policies. Through simulation exercises, we analyze the impact of GI policies on production decisions, exporting behavior and market share allocation across the GI and non-GI sectors. We identify welfare-maximizing domestic and international GI policies and unveil a novel mechanism for welfare gains in international markets. This mechanism is driven by the interaction between domestic and international GI policies, leading to an inter-sectoral reallocation of market shares toward firms with higher productivity. Additionally, we formulate empirically testable hypotheses and provide policy recommendations. Our work provides a structural basis for future empirical research on the role of GI policies in shaping export behavior and productivity in global agri-food markets.
abstract_zh: 地理标志（GIs）在全球农产品市场及贸易协定中日益成为重要特征，然而经济学文献中缺乏一个结构性的开放经济模型来分析地理标志政策如何影响出口、生产率与福利。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个国际贸易的一般均衡模型，该模型捕捉了地理标志生产与政策在国内及国际市场中的关键特征。生产特征包括地理标志产品的工艺性及地理标志生产者的集体文化。地理标志政策侧重于制度框架及对地理标志集体管理的财政支持，以及地理标志标签的行政保护（依职权保护）。该模型能够适应各国在地理标志部门禀赋及地理标志政策实施与力度上的不对称性。通过模拟实验，我们分析了地理标志政策对生产决策、出口行为及地理标志与非地理标志部门间市场份额分配的影响。我们识别出福利最大化的国内及国际地理标志政策，并揭示了国际市场福利增益的新机制。该机制由国内与国际地理标志政策的相互作用驱动，导致市场份额向生产率更高的企业进行跨部门重新配置。此外，我们提出了可实证检验的假设并提供了政策建议。我们的工作为未来关于地理标志政策在塑造全球农产品市场出口行为与生产率方面作用的实证研究提供了结构性基础。
